provenance.notes: Values are parsed from local event records and gridded/statistical inputs.

criteria.description: Gives record_reported_giant_hail or an equivalent concise label that makes reported giant hail the headline signal.
criteria.name: Headline label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for naming severe hail without clearly making it the headline; award 0 for a rain/wind or image-change headline.

criteria.description: Includes 19 cm, the 10 cm giant-hail threshold, and the 1.90 threshold multiple with correct units or equivalent wording.
criteria.name: Hail ledger arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct hail values with one missing derived value; award 1 for qualitative large-hail wording only.

criteria.description: Includes 22 of 24 Italy giant-hail reports, 91.7% Italy share, 109 injuries, and 4.54 injuries per giant-hail report.
criteria.name: Report concentration and injury normalization
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for partial report or injury values without the normalization; award 1 point for qualitative injury/report-concentration wording only.

criteria.description: Uses at least two weather or gridded precipitation anchors and keeps them secondary to the hail ledger.
criteria.name: Weather context comparison
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct rain or wind values but weak comparison.

criteria.description: States that imagery and embedding-change statistics provide broad context only, not a direct hail-damage or loss count.
criteria.name: Image context boundary
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mentioning image context without clearly excluding direct damage-count use.

criteria.description: Avoids exact monetary, crop, roof, vehicle, or building-loss counts unless computed, and does not treat image-change statistics as counted hail damage.
criteria.name: Damage-count discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for minor extra detail that does not change the headline.

criteria.description: Returns a concise JSON-like or similarly structured answer with the requested fields and a one-sentence conclusion.
criteria.name: Compact answer format
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct content in a loose paragraph format or with missing fields.
